content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was an inconsistency in the handling of the VIDIOC_DQEVENT ioctl for compatibility mode across different architectures. The previous fix introduced a reliance on the native handler for 32-bit code on non-x86 architectures, which led to compatibility issues when those architectures could not use the same conversion helper as x86. This resulted in the inability to correctly handle the VIDIOC_DQEVENT_TIME32 code in compatibility mode, breaking functionality for non-x86 architectures. The patch aimed to generalize the handling of VIDIOC_DQEVENT32_TIME32 to ensure consistent behavior across all architectures.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: - * On all other architectures, v4l2_event32 and v4l2_event32_time32 are
- * the same as v4l2_event and v4l2_event_time32, so we can use the native
- * handlers, converting v4l2_event to v4l2_event_time32 if necessary.
